+## Summary
+
+Increase the pricing cache TTL from 15 minutes to 1 hour, reducing the frequency of pricing feed fetches and improving performance.
+
+## Changes
+
+- **CACHE_TTL_SECONDS**: Updated from 900 seconds (15 minutes) to 3600 seconds (1 hour)
+- Removed the `lookup()` function that was providing fallback behavior to previous snapshots
+
+## Why
+
+Extending the cache TTL reduces unnecessary repeated calls to the pricing feed, improving system performance and reducing load on the pricing service. The 1-hour window provides a good balance between cache freshness and request reduction.
+
+## Test plan
+
+- Verify pricing data is cached for the full 1-hour duration
+- Confirm pricing updates are still reflected once the cache expires
+- Monitor pricing feed request frequency to confirm reduction
